steps.prompt: A straight-on preschool tablet game reward screen made as a cream wool-felt quilt page inside a thick cobalt stitched border. Loose felt confetti dots and curled scraps decorate the edges; a wide empty cobalt felt action plaque sits near the bottom. Premium handmade quiet-book craft made entirely from real wool felt, woven denim, chunky cream blanket stitching, fuzzy fabric, and brushed metal. Rounded safe forms, soft studio lighting, shallow physical shadows, deep navy cobalt orange leaf green lavender cream and sunflower palette, coherent single visual system, polished preschool app composition.
